result.reasoning_summary: Commit implements provider-authentication metadata contract (FWQ-0070/FW-HARNESS-006) with strict enforcement of credential binding and secret rejection. ProviderAuthProfile declares provider-specific classes without activation; CredentialRecord persists metadata with opaque fwkeys:// handles only; CredentialBroker enforces deterministic admission gate validating provider/model/tenant/identity/method/scope/expiry/approval/revocation binding without resolving secrets or calling providers. Secret-detection regexes reject raw credentials and secret-like material in persistent form. Gemini CLI explicitly "agy". Broker exposes no mutation/refresh/exchange/revoke/resolve methods. All 102 tests pass, covering profile validation, identity binding, approval/revocation/expiry, secret rejection, round-tripping, and scope enforcement. Patch is narrow (2 new files, 279 lines), deterministic (frozen dataclasses, no I/O), and isolated with no integration points.
